I will not put chemical fertilizer on this plot this season. Last season I managed without it, and here in Shinyanga the rain can fool a man, so I will not risk that money on a big intercropped field. I own this land, so I will carry some manure to the parts near home, I will keep my local seed, and I will hire people for clearing and weeding because this plot is too big for family hands alone. I will not irrigate, but I will use spray if weeds or pests start taking the field.
